explanation: The weak version proved by Kahn–Kalai: for each ε > 0 there is C_ε such that some p ∈ [n^{−ε}t, t] is (C log(1/p), p)-optimal. The MO post describes this as "1000 log n replaced by C_ε n^ε", and the Lean form, with constant C in the optimality factor and window ratio n^ε, is equivalent up to constants. The statement is correct and solved.
